proves.claim: With runners.selfUpdate on, the entry passes serveRunner the runnerCode port for its own install folder and exits 0 when serveRunner returns asking for a restart.

cli.io-runner-service.self-update-on-pas.why: Without it, a regression where with runners.selfUpdate on, the entry passes serveRunner the runnerCode port for its own install folder and exits 0 when serveRunner returns asking for a restart would pass unnoticed.

proves.claim: With runners.selfUpdate off, the entry passes no runnerCode port and serves as today.

cli.io-runner-service.self-update-off-pa.why: Without it, a regression where with runners.selfUpdate off, the entry passes no runnerCode port and serves as today would pass unnoticed.
